Reserve Bank of Australia — Monetary Policy Decision

Date: 4 August 2026

At its meeting today, the Board decided to lower the cash rate target by 25 basis points to 4.10 per cent.

The Board remains focused on the persistence of inflation and the strength of the labour market. The outlook remains highly uncertain.

The Board is not ruling anything in or out. The Board will continue to monitor emerging data. The future path of interest rates will depend on incoming data.
